import sys

# 3-level 11-bit precomputed tables (2048 entries per level, <1ms init)
# Any n % 2_000_000_016 < 2^31 < 2^33, so 3 levels of 11 bits cover all n!
MOD = 1_000_000_007

def _build():
    F0 = [0] * 2049
    a, b = 0, 1
    F0[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, 2049):
        a, b = b, (a + b) % MOD
        F0[i] = b

    # Step for level 1: 2^11 = 2048
    s0, s1 = F0[2047], F0[2048]
    F1_0 = [0] * 1024
    F1_1 = [0] * 1024
    a, b = 0, 1
    F1_1[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 1024):
        a, b = (a * s0 + b * s1) % MOD, (a * s1 + b * (s0 + s1)) % MOD
        F1_0[i] = a
        F1_1[i] = b

    # Step for level 2: 2^21 = 1024 * 2048
    t0 = (a * s0 + b * s1) % MOD
    t1 = (a * s1 + b * (s0 + s1)) % MOD
    F2_0 = [0] * 1024
    F2_1 = [0] * 1024
    a, b = 0, 1
    F2_1[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 1024):
        a, b = (a * t0 + b * t1) % MOD, (a * t1 + b * (t0 + t1)) % MOD
        F2_0[i] = a
        F2_1[i] = b

    return F0, F1_0, F1_1, F2_0, F2_1

_F0, _F1_0, _F1_1, _F2_0, _F2_1 = _build()

class _Fib(dict):
    def __missing__(self, orig_n):
        n = orig_n % 2_000_000_016
        if n <= 2048:
            res = _F0[n]
            self[orig_n] = res
            return res
        i0 = n & 2047
        i1 = (n >> 11) & 1023
        i2 = n >> 21
        a0, a1 = _F0[i0], _F0[i0 + 1]
        if i1:
            b0, b1 = _F1_0[i1], _F1_1[i1]
            a0, a1 = (a0 * b0 + a1 * b1) % 1_000_000_007, (a0 * b1 + a1 * (b0 + b1)) % 1_000_000_007
        if i2:
            c0, c1 = _F2_0[i2], _F2_1[i2]
            res = (a0 * c0 + a1 * c1) % 1_000_000_007
        else:
            res = a0
        self[orig_n] = res
        return res

fib = _Fib().__getitem__

if __name__ == "__main__":

import sys

# Precompute 14-bit Fibonacci numbers (up to 16384)
_F = [0, 1]
_a, _b = 0, 1
for _ in range(16384):
    _a, _b = _b, (_a + _b) % 1_000_000_007
    _F.append(_b)

class _Fib(dict):
    def __missing__(self, orig_n):
        n = orig_n % 2_000_000_016
        if n <= 16384:
            res = _F[n]
            self[orig_n] = res
            return res
        bl = n.bit_length()
        top = bl - 14
        idx = n >> top
        a, b = _F[idx], _F[idx + 1]
        for i in range(top - 1, 0, -1):
            c = a * ((b << 1) - a) % 1_000_000_007
            d = (a * a + b * b) % 1_000_000_007
            if (n >> i) & 1:
                a, b = d, (c + d) % 1_000_000_007
            else:
                a, b = c, d
        if n & 1:
            res = (a * a + b * b) % 1_000_000_007
        else:
            res = a * ((b << 1) - a) % 1_000_000_007
        self[orig_n] = res
        return res

fib = _Fib().__getitem__

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(fib(int(sys.argv[1])))
